svg.title: A first request against its floor, version by version
svg.desc: How many times its hardware floor a one-question first request takes, against its prompt length on a log scale, for each version of the engine. MLX's kernels: 93 tokens 2.16x, 285 tokens 1.59x, 481 tokens 1.28x, 1069 tokens 1.23x, 2049 tokens 1.20x, 4009 tokens 1.21x, 7929 tokens 1.24x, 15769 tokens 1.20x, 31449 tokens 1.21x, 47129 tokens 1.21x, 61437 tokens 1.23x. first matmul and SwiGLU work: 93 tokens 1.94x, 285 tokens 1.35x, 481 tokens 1.19x, 1069 tokens 1.13x, 2049 tokens 1.16x, 4009 tokens 1.21x, 7929 tokens 1.23x, 15769 tokens 1.22x, 31449 tokens 1.19x, 47129 tokens 1.21x, 61437 tokens 1.23x. threadgroup and tuning fixes: 93 tokens 1.83x, 285 tokens 1.30x, 481 tokens 1.17x, 1089 tokens 1.16x, 2089 tokens 1.11x, 4089 tokens 1.11x, 8089 tokens 1.12x, 16087 tokens 1.10x, 32089 tokens 1.13x, 48089 tokens 1.16x, 60089 tokens 1.23x.
svg.text: A first request against its floor, version by version
one question, end to end, the time over the floor; lower is better, 1.0x is the hardware
the floor: FLOPs at 33 TFLOPS, or the weights at 307 GB/s
